title: Business & Operations Manager - President's Office
description:
**About Kingston Educational Institute** 




  





 Established in 2004, Kingston Educational Institute (KEI) is a multidisciplinary educational group based in Barasat, West Bengal, offering school education and higher education across management, science, law, technical education, and teacher training. Kingston also runs a 110 bedded hospital namely Kingston General Hospital. KEI focuses on academic learning, practical skills, and career readiness to prepare students for professional success.
 



 This role offers the opportunity to work closely with management and contribute to institutional operations, technology adoption, and projects across the KEI Management's varied business initiatives.
 



  





**Website:** 
 www.keical.edu.in
 



  





**Location:** 
 Barasat, West Bengal
 



  





**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**Reporting To:** 
 President
 



  





**Travel:** 
 Business travel with the President and to project locations, as required
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a versatile, dependable, and hands\-on professional to work closely with the President across business operations, executive support, and project implementation. You will manage schedules, routine administrative tasks, follow\-ups, documentation, and operational challenges while supporting admissions, HR, finance, sales \& marketing , project , operations and technology adoption. The role spans the President ’s various businesses and initiatives and requires someone who can adapt to different teams, sectors, and priorities. This position suits someone who takes ownership, follows through consistently, handles confidential information with discretion, and is willing to learn, unlearn, and relearn.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





***President’s Office and Executive Support***




  




* Manage the President’s calendar, meetings, schedules, reminders, and daily priorities.
* Prepare meeting agendas, record minutes, track action items, and follow up until completion.
* Handle routine administrative tasks, correspondence, documentation, and record management.
* Coordinate with employees, vendors, consultants, and business partners on behalf of management.
* Handle sensitive management, employee, financial, and business information with strict confidentiality.



  





***Business Operations and Project Management***




  




* Execute assigned projects across the management’s businesses, tracking timelines, responsibilities, deliverables, and progress.
* Identify operational problems, coordinate practical solutions, and escalate issues requiring management decisions.
* Prepare and maintain standard operating procedures, project documents, presentations, and management reports.
* Improve workflows and support consistent implementation of business processes.
* Take on varied assignments across functions, including detailed administrative work and on\-site execution.



  





***Admissions, CRM, and Communication***




  




* Work hands\-on during admission seasons, supporting enquiry handling, applicant follow\-ups, counselling coordination, documentation, and enrolment.
* Use and maintain CRM systems to ensure accurate records, timely communication, and effective tracking of the admissions pipeline.
* Help develop and execute communication strategies for prospective students, parents, partners, and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate calls, emails, messages, and campaigns with admissions, sales, and marketing teams.
* Monitor enquiry response times, follow\-up completion, conversions, and admission targets, recommending improvements where needed.



  





***HR and Finance \& Sales Coordination***




  




* Support recruitment coordination, onboarding, employee documentation, and routine HR administration.
* Coordinate with finance teams on budgets, expenses, invoices, payments, and financial reporting.
* Coordinate with Sales \& Marketing team to concise their reports and outcomes for management viewing.
* Conduct standup meetings with various departments to gather each of the departments progress of given tasks , KPIs and KRAs.
* Maintain accurate trackers and supporting records for HR, finance, and operational activities.
* Follow organisational policies and approval processes, working with relevant specialists when required.



  





***Excel, Reporting, and Data Visualization***




  




* Use Excel and advanced Excel to organise, analyse, and report business data.
* Create and maintain trackers, management reports, and dashboards for admissions, HR, finance, operations, and projects.
* Work confidently with PivotTables, lookup functions, conditional formulas, charts, and Power Query.
* Present clear data visualizations that help management monitor performance, identify trends, and make decisions.
* Check data accuracy and improve recurring reporting processes.



  





***ERP Implementation and Change Management***




  




* Coordinate and support ERP and other business\-system implementations, from requirements gathering and workflow documentation through testing and rollout.
* Work with vendors and internal teams on configuration, data preparation, migration, and issue resolution.
* Prepare user guides, coordinate training, and support employees in adopting new systems.
* Participate actively in change management initiatives across the management’s businesses.
* Monitor adoption, gather feedback, and follow through on improvements after implementation.



  





***Business Travel and Cross\-Business Support***




  




* Be willing to travel with the President for business meetings, site visits, operational reviews, and project implementations.
* Travel independently to project locations when required.
* Support assignments across the mangement’s varied business interests, adapting to different sectors and operating environments.
* Coordinate meeting schedules, prepare relevant documents, and follow up on decisions and commitments arising from business visits.
* Provide hands\-on support at project locations, working with local teams and partners to implement processes and resolve operational issues.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* MBA from a recognised institution is mandatory.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Prior professional experience in HR, Sales, or Operations.
* Working knowledge of HR processes, business operations, and basic finance.
* Strong practical proficiency in Excel and advanced Excel, including reporting, dashboards, and data visualization.
* Ability to use CRM platforms and learn ERP and other business applications.
* Strong written and verbal communication, interpersonal skills , documentation, and coordination skills are non negotiable for this role.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and take assignments through to completion.
* Professional judgment, reliability, and discretion when handling confidential information.
* Willingness to travel and work across the mangement’s various businesses and project locations.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Experience in the education, training, or skill\-development sector.
* Exposure to admissions, student engagement, sales processes, or lead conversion.
* Experience in ERP implementation, process improvement, or change management.
* Familiarity with Power BI or similar data visualization tools.
* Experience working directly with founders, senior leaders, or management teams.
* Candidates from other industries are welcome to apply. An open mind, willingness to understand new sectors, and ability to learn, unlearn, and relearn are essential.



  





***Personal Attributes***




  




* **Hands\-on approach:** 
 Willingness to handle routine tasks and take ownership of tasks ,problems and solutions.

title: Owner
description:
**Company Description** 
 Freelance is an independently owned and operated business based in Rajarhat, focused on delivering tailored services to local clients and partners. The company structure is lean and flexible, allowing rapid decision\-making and close collaboration with stakeholders. As an owner\-led venture, Freelance emphasizes accountability, quality of service, and long\-term relationships. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas, support business growth, and adapt to evolving client needs. The environment is dynamic and hands\-on, offering exposure to multiple aspects of running a business.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Owner role at Freelance is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Rajarhat, responsible for overseeing all aspects of business operations and growth. Day\-to\-day tasks include managing client relationships, supervising projects and service delivery, and ensuring customer satisfaction. The Owner will handle budgeting, basic accounting activities, and vendor coordination, while monitoring performance and identifying opportunities to expand services or reach new markets. This role also involves setting strategic goals, maintaining compliance with relevant regulations, and leading any team members or partners involved in the business. The position requires a hands\-on approach, with regular on\-site presence to address operational issues, support staff, and maintain strong community and client engagement.
   

**Qualifications**
* Demonstrated ability to manage day\-to\-day business operations, including planning, organizing, and overseeing service delivery.
* Experience in client relationship management and stakeholder communication, with strong negotiation and interpersonal skills.
* Basic proficiency in financial management, such as budgeting, expense tracking, and coordinating with accountants or financial advisors.
* Comfort with handling administrative tasks, documentation, and compliance with local regulations and business requirements.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, the capacity to make informed decisions, and a proactive attitude toward business development.
* Ability to work on\-site full time in Rajarhat and maintain a consistent presence to support operations and customer interactions.
* Prior experience in running a small business, managing a team, or working in an entrepreneurial environment is beneficial.
* Relevant education or training in business, management, or a related field is an advantage but not strictly required if experience is substantial.

title: Daglig leder til Stenløse Private Skovbørnehave
description:
Stenløse Private Skovbørnehave er en hyggelig privat institution med omkring 20 dejlige skovbørn, hvor der er masser af hjertevarme, glæde og fællesskab.
   

  

 Institutionen blev grundlagt i 1970 og har i dag base i Stenløse Egedal Kommune. Hver dag, året rundt kører vi på eventyr i skov og ved strand i vores trofaste bus ”Rumle”. Vi bruger alt vores tid ude, og vores mål er at lære børnene at færdes i naturen, vise dem hvor givende naturen er, med bl.a. læring om respekt for dyr og plantelivet.
   

  

 Nærvær og indlevelse, glæde og latter er det centrale omdrejningspunkt i vores hverdag. Vi sætter en ære i at alle har haft en god dag, når de går hjem.
   

  

 Du vil blive leder for en dynamisk og engageret personalegruppe med hver deres kompetencer, som har et tæt samarbejde – både blandt hinanden, men også med forældregruppen og bestyrelsen. Vores værdier og menneskesyn udspringer af anerkendelse og respekt over for hinanden – store som små, og at møde barnet der hvor det er, og bidrage til selvværd og selvudvikling hos det enkelte barn. Vi bruger alle rammerne i naturen til at skabe læring, sjov og glæde. Vi har særlig fokus på leg, bevægelse, kreativitet og sociale fællesskaber samt børneyoga og mindfulness.
   

  

 Personaleledelse, administration og samarbejde
   

  

 Stenløse Private Skovbørnehave består af en personalegruppe på 4 personer og mellem 20 og 30 skønne skovbørn. Du skal have overblik, være struktureret og god til at samarbejde. Jobbet indebærer en række administrative opgaver, herunder budgetansvar, ugeplanlægning, ventelistehåndtering, opfølgning, personale\- og forældresamtaler, svare henvendelser på mail og telefon mv. Økonomi og administration vil foregå i tæt dialog med bestyrelsen og Landsorganisationen Danske Daginstitutioner – LDD som vi er medlem af.
   

  

 Arbejdet vil være fordelt således, at der i gennemsnit er 2 faste dage om ugen til kontor og de resterende dage er du med i skoven.
   

  

 Profil
   

  

* Du er uddannet pædagog og har gerne erfaring ledelse fra tidligere job.
* Du skal kunne lide at færdes i naturen og har flair for udelivet.
* Du har økonomisk overblik, arbejder struktureret og har it\-forståelser.
* Du skal kunne bevæge dig i krydsfeltet mellem at være på børn og være leder.
* Du besidder empati og kan skabe tryghed og omsorg for det enkelte barn og gruppen som helhed.
* Du kan udvise ansvarlighed overfor børnehavens værdier og koncept.
* Du kan samarbejde med åben dialog, forståelse og tydelig kommunikation.
* Du kan inspirere og er god til sparring og opbygge et positivt samarbejdsklima.


 Vi søger dig, som har lyst til at indgå i et spændende og givende job, hvor du vil få stor indflydelse på, at vores børn får den bedste start på livet ved at gå i en skovbørnehave.
   

  

 Stillingen er på 37 timer og til besættelse snarest muligt. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler. Frist for ansøgning er 14\. oktober 2026\.
   

  

 Har du lyst til at høre mere om stillingen, kan du ringe til vores formand Cecilie Wium\-Tellefsen på 28 15 95 13\.
   

  

 Din ansøgning sendes til formand@skovboernehave.dk, og du bedes vedhæfte CV, uddannelsespapirer, kursusbeviser, udtalelser, referencer og/eller andre relevante papirer.
   

  

 Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning!

title: Shift In-charge - Power Plant
description:
**Shift In\-Charge – Power Plant** 




**Company:** 
 IMP Engineering \& Power Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Power Generation / Captive Power Plant
 



**Location:** 
 Jharkhand, India
 



**Experience:** 
 5–7 Years
 



**Qualification:** 
 B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
 



 Job Summary
 



 IMP Engineering \& Power Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced
 **Shift In\-Charge** 
 to supervise the day\-to\-day operation of a
 **Captive Power Plant** 
 . The candidate will be responsible for ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient plant operation during the assigned shift, coordinating operating teams, monitoring equipment performance, and achieving operational targets.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Supervise complete shift operations of the power plant, including
 **Boiler, Turbine, CHP, and associated auxiliaries** 
 .
* Monitor operating parameters through
 **DCS/control room and field operations** 
 and take appropriate corrective action.
* Coordinate with Boiler, Turbine, Electrical, CHP, WTP, and Maintenance teams for smooth plant operation.
* Ensure safe start\-up, shutdown, load changes, and emergency handling as per established operating procedures.
* Monitor boiler and turbine performance and maintain stable plant load and operating conditions.
* Coordinate with maintenance teams for equipment abnormalities, breakdowns, and planned maintenance activities.
* Ensure proper coal/fuel handling and availability of required utilities during the shift.
* Maintain shift logs, operational records, generation reports, and equipment performance data.
* Ensure compliance with plant safety procedures, statutory requirements, and company operating standards.
* Supervise operators and technicians and ensure proper manpower deployment during the shift.
* Identify operational problems and coordinate troubleshooting to minimize downtime.
* Conduct shift handovers and communicate critical plant conditions and pending activities to the incoming shift team.



 Required Skills \& Experience
 


* **4\-5 years minimum of relevant experience** 
 in Thermal Power Plant / Captive Power Plant / Co\-Generation Plant operations.
* Strong practical knowledge of
 **Boiler and Turbine operations** 
 .
* Experience in
 **DCS\-based plant operation** 
 will be preferred.
* Good understanding of plant auxiliaries, CHP, electrical systems, and utility systems.
* Ability to lead and coordinate shift manpower effectively.
* Strong troubleshooting, decision\-making, and communication skills.
* Knowledge of industrial safety practices and operational procedures.



 Qualification
 



**B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, or related Engineering discipline.** 
 Candidates with relevant experience in captive, co\-generation, sugar, distillery, or process\-industry power plants will be considered.
 



 Immediate Requirement
 



**Immediate joiners / candidates with short notice periods will be preferred.** 




**Interested candidates can apply with their updated CV.** 




**Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹42,000\.00 per month** 




**Benefits:** 



* Health insurance
* Provident Fund
* Work Location: In person



  





 Apply now or send your CV to hr@impepl.com \| hr.corporate@impepl.com

title: Cleaning Specialist II
description:
**Description**
 The Portland Area Manager will play a crucial role in managing our janitorial teams across various sites, ensuring that all cleaning and maintenance tasks meet our high standards of quality and efficiency. This position requires a balance of leadership, customer service, and operational expertise, as well as a commitment to health and safety protocols.
   

  

 Technical Skills
   

  

* Oversee the daily operations of janitorial services across multiple locations, ensuring all standards of cleanliness and maintenance are met or exceeded.
* Manage, train, and develop a team of janitors and supervisors, promoting a culture of high performance, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct regular site inspections and audits to assess the quality of work performed, identifying areas for improvement and implementing corrective actions as necessary.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, understanding their needs and ensuring their satisfaction with our services.
* Ensure compliance with all health and safety regulations, promoting a safe working environment for all employees.
* Manage inventory of cleaning supplies and equipment, ensuring that teams have the necessary resources to perform their duties effectively.
* Prepare and manage budgets for janitorial operations, including labor costs, supplies, and equipment maintenance.
* Address and resolve any issues or complaints from clients or staff promptly and professionally.
* Implement and monitor sustainability practices in cleaning methods and products.
* Prepare reports and analyses on operational activities, performance metrics, and other relevant data for senior management.
